body:
QUALITY IS NOT TESTED, BUT BUILT.”

Here’s an interesting book recommended by Grace Kongo, Test Analyst at q-leap: Business Analysis, Software Testing, Usability: A Quick Guide Book for Better Project Management and Faster IT Career by Koray Yitmen.

This book examines all three disciplines and links them together. Throughout the book, different perspectives are discussed, providing interesting comparisons and relationships between business analysis, software testing and usability-related disciplines.

“THE AUTHOR, KORAY YITMEN SHOWS THE WAY AND I HIGHLY RECOMMEND YOU READ THIS BOOK!” G. KONGO

“Quality isn’t tested, it’s built” This expression has been around for decades, but many organizations today are either unaware of its truth, or try to ignore it. The author reminds us that quality isn’t something added at the end of product creation, like spreading icing on a cake; it has to be part of the creation process from the very beginning. Organizations that build quality products right from the start can devote their resources to innovating for their next opportunities. Those who build poor-quality products have to use their resources to respond to unhappy customers and repair faulty products. Although the correct choice seems obvious, many still don’t understand it.

About the author: Koray Yitmen is a board member of the local chapter of the International Institute of Business Analysis (IIBA), president of the local chapter of the International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) and president of the local chapter of the User Experience Professionals’ Association (UXPA). He vigorously defends the business motto “Quality isn’t tested, it’s built”, and strives to put this motto into practice in every IT project he takes part in. His greatest joy in life is giving back to the community. One hundred percent of the net proceeds from sales of this book will be donated to elementary school initiatives.

ABOUT OUR Q-LEAP EXPERT WHO RECOMMENDS THIS BOOK


Grace Kongo is a Test Analyst at q-leap with in-depth expertise in test plan design, test case execution, reporting and defect management with the appropriate tools. She is a strong team member, has excellent customer communication skills, and is fully committed to her career in software testing.

Written by : Koray Yitmen
Recommended reading by Grace Kongo, Test Analyst at q-leap
